source.eod: NSE daily F&O file of 2026-10-12: close, settlement, open interest and its change, volume (no bid or ask)
source.index: NSE daily index file (NIFTY 50, India VIX)

quotes.text: The F&O tool's 3 pm recording of bid and ask (the nearest two monthly expiries, strikes within 5% of NIFTY) started on 13 Oct 2026. Its quotes appear here once the tool publishes them; until then no paper order can be priced.

computed.iv: Black-Scholes from the day's close, only when the contract traded; rate 6.5%, no dividend; calendar days to expiry / 365
computed.chance: Risk-neutral: what the option's own price implies, not a forecast

payload.books: No F&O book holds a position: no strategy has passed testing yet, so each book records “no approved strategy” at 3 pm.
